body: @priyanknarvekar I wasn't able to reproduce the problem with [grpc-plain-text-quickstart](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/tree/main/grpc-plain-text-quickstart) and Quarkus 2.15.2.Final/999-SNAPSHOT. Could you share your project?

so found the property that causing the issue, 
I have enable the same port for grpc  as per  `Using legacy gRPC support, with separate new HTTP server instance. Switch to single HTTP server instance usage with quarkus.grpc.server.use-separate-server=false property`

when I set the same property in [grpc-plain-text-quickstart](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/tree/main/grpc-plain-text-quickstart) that fails to load the dev ui for grpc as well.

This enables the usage of the new Vert.x gRPC impl, which re-uses existing HTTP server, and that runs on either default port 8080 (or quarkus.http.port property, if set) or 8081 for tests.
Dunno how that could mess-up Dev UI ...
Looks like a class loading issue. I can try to take a look later today but I have no idea either...

issue.title: gRPC Dev UI - fix problems when reusing the existing HTTP server
